research_query: What are the economic impacts of AI on the labor market?
analysis:
## Analysis: Economic Impacts of AI

AI adoption has grown 50% since 2020. Routine cognitive tasks face displacement. New jobs are emerging in AI-adjacent fields. Policy responses include retraining programs.

### Sources
- [AI Report 2025](https://example.com/ai-report)
- [Jobs and AI Study](https://example.com/jobs-ai)

research_query: How effective are current carbon capture technologies?
analysis:
## Analysis: Carbon Capture Technologies

DAC costs $250-600/ton. Post-combustion capture costs $40-120/ton. Current capacity is 45 Mt/year, far below gigatons needed.
